## What's New in v1.6.4 — Brand Green #1DBF73 & About Modal

### 💚 Fresh Brand Palette & About Screen
- **Brand Green #1DBF73 Accent:** Updated primary action color to vibrant green `#1DBF73` for buttons, switches, and active indicators.
- **Pure White Background:** Clean `#FFFFFF` background with razor-sharp dark charcoal body text `#404145`.
- **Top Header Refinement:** `WA RuntimeKit` title text rendered cleanly over pure background with zero tint boxes.
- **About Sheet Modal (`AboutModal`):** Added top-right Info icon button launching an interactive sheet with direct links to ZeroTrace GitHub Repository, Releases & Updates, and Engineering Team.
